- tests/test_validate_target_ref_input.py, location: `_validate_support_ref`

  WHY: The first assertion then fails with a message that points at the workflow instead of the missing tool. Suggested minimal fix: `assert shutil.which("jq"), "jq is required to run the support-ref selection"` at the top of the helper, plus `import shutil`. Estimated lines changed: 2. The PR adds the new log line `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF ref=… workflow_ref=…` and changes which commit validation support is staged from. The "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry in `agents.md` is what workflow-log analysis relies on.
  Expected change site: a new `agents.d/7123-validate-support-follows-pin.md`.
  Evidence of absence:
  - The PR touches only `.github/workflows/validate.yml`, `changelog.d/7123-validate-support-follows-pin.md` and `tests/test_validate_target_ref_input.py`.
  - `agents.d/` holds only `6633-…`, `6712-…`, `7058-…` and its README, and the README requires one fragment per PR with a section marker.
  - The neighbouring prefixes `VALIDATE_TRUSTED_SUPPORT` and `VALIDATE_TRUSTED_SUPPORT_OVERRIDE` are registered in `agents.md`; `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF` is not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Validation should use one consistent version of the workflow and its scripts when a pin falls behind.
  Expected change site: the other support-fetching steps in `.github/workflows/validate.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: three places in the same job still use a moving `stable` ref regardless of the pin.
  - "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" uses `ghr_ref=stable` (lines 114-122).
  - "Resolve integration ref" uses `resolver_ref="stable"` (line 150).
  - `setup-runtime@stable` is a literal action ref (line 325).
  Consequence: the "one consistent version" claim in the changelog is broader than what the PR delivers. Either narrow the changelog wording to "support scripts staged by 'Fetch workflow support files'", or state that these helpers are deliberately left on `stable`. The retry helper and resolver are lower risk, because the main scripts now follow the pin.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  File: agents.d/7123-validate-support-follows-pin.md
  Line or code reference: not present
  Problem: PR adds the new log line `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF ref=… workflow_ref=…` (validate.yml:355) but does not register the prefix in the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry.
  Why it fails at runtime: agents.md states "Workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting depend on these stable log prefixes. Renames are breaking unless an alongside-old shim is documented and shipped." Sibling prefixes `VALIDATE_TRUSTED_SUPPORT_OVERRIDE` and `VALIDATE_TRUSTED_SUPPORT` are already registered; `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF` is not, so the workflow-log analysis tooling will not recognise or surface the new line. §30 (and its mirrors) require this be shipped as an `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` fragment with the bullet `- `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF` (`scripts/...` location)` plus a `LOG_PREFIX.name=VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF` line, not a direct edit.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  File: .github/workflows/validate.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 104-133 ("Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper"), 135-221 ("Resolve integration ref"), 325 (`setup-runtime@stable`)
  Problem: PR description frames the fix as "validation uses one consistent version of the workflow and its scripts when a pin falls behind" but only the "Fetch workflow support files" step (now lines 332-391) follows the pinned commit. Three other support-script entry points in the same job still take support from a moving ref.
  - "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" sets `ghr_ref=stable` (line 114) and clones from `stable` (or `main` in this repo) for `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` and `scripts/emit_event.sh`.
  - "Resolve integration ref" sets `resolver_ref="stable"` (line 150) and fetches that ref via `git fetch origin "${resolver_ref}"` (line 173) to stage `scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh`.
  - "Setup shared runtime" pins the composite action as `uses: shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/.github/actions/setup-runtime@stable` (line 325), a literal moving-ref action.
  Why it fails at runtime: the binance-blessings#249 reproduction cited in the PR depends on every consumer-runnable script coming from the pinned commit. With only "Fetch workflow support files" retargeted, an old pin still hits a same-shape failure on the helper script (`gh_helpers.sh`) the very next step sources, on the integration-ref resolver, and on the runtime setup action that drives the rest of the job.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
